items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Then later on I met Humphrey at the London House

ctx.x: Then later on I met Humphrey at the London House, and he come by. He said, "I just had to come by and see you." He said, "I never asked nobody for an autograph in my life, but I want an autograph from you. I want two, for my daughters."
Well, I never. Isn't that nice.
